mapper.select: SELECT pp.P_id as pId, pp.P_Name, gt.Task_Text, gs.Gs_Section, gt.Task_Type, gp.Plan_Start, gp.Plan_End, gt.Task_Start_Date, gt.Task_End_Date, gto.* FROM gantt_tasks_overdue gto LEFT JOIN gantt_tasks gt ON gto.Task_ID = gt.Task_Id LEFT JOIN gant_section gs ON gt.gs_id = gs.id LEFT JOIN gantt_plan gp ON gt.Plan_Id = gp.Plan_Id LEFT JOIN pre_project pp ON gp.P_Id = pp.P_ID WHERE gto.Task_Id = #{taskId}

SELECT gp.P_Id as pId, pp.P_Name, gt.Task_Text, gs.Gs_Section, gt.Task_Type, gp.Plan_Start, gp.Plan_End, gt.task_Importance, gt.Task_Start_Date, gt.Task_End_Date, gt.task_Begin_Time, gt.task_Finish_Time, gto.* FROM gantt_tasks_overdue gto LEFT JOIN gantt_tasks gt ON gto.Task_ID = gt.Task_Id LEFT JOIN gant_section gs ON gt.gs_id = gs.id LEFT JOIN gantt_plan gp ON gt.Plan_Id = gp.Plan_Id LEFT JOIN pre_project pp ON gp.P_Id = pp.P_ID WHERE gto.id = #{id}
